messages:
Jules Park: Heads-up: my docs PR for SDK snippet updates is failing the preview CI. Need a quick hand — customer QA tomorrow morning.
Nina Patel: PR link?
Jules Park: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4312 
ci-bot: PR #4312 CI summary: docs-preview: failed (render error in snippets.md), linkcheck: failed (2 external 404s), vale: failed (VALE SBL001: consider active voice), spellcheck: failed (typo: "accomodate" -> accommodate).
Ethan Holt: I can pick up the typo + vale phrasing. 
Kai Becker: I'll look at linkcheck. Often the 404s are old example repos — either replace with our mirror or archive link.
Jules Park: The snippet error is weird: preview log shows "fenced code block without language" at line ~78 in snippets.md. I must've pasted a shell block without ```bash.
Nina Patel: For speed, add a one-line commit that sets the code fence to ```bash and fixes the spelling. Run `make docs-preview` locally to sanity-check.
Ethan Holt: Rewriting passive voice: change "is used to" -> "uses" and "is recommended" -> "we recommend". That should clear vale alerts.
Kai Becker: Found the 404s: links to github.com/old-org/redis-example and docs.oldsite.io/kv. I'll swap the first to our internal example repo and replace the second with a web.archive.org snapshot.
docs-bot: Reminder: small editorial fixes qualify for `docs:quick-merge`. Please add the label and request any available approver.
Jules Park: I'm pushing a tiny commit with fence lang + typo + wording + link replacements. Will re-trigger CI when done.
ci-bot: Running checks...
ci-bot: linkcheck: passed; spellcheck: passed; vale: passed (no alerts); docs-preview: success  preview URL: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/pr-4312 
Nina Patel: Preview looks good on mobile and desktop. Snippet syntax highlighting is fixed.
Ethan Holt: LGTM. I'll approve.
Kai Becker: Approved. Merging should be fine.
Jules Park: Added label `docs-urgent` and `docs:quick-merge`, merging now. Thanks team for the fast help!
Nina Patel: Nice. Good luck with QA tomorrow.
Jules Park: Will report back after the demo. If anything else trips, I'll open a follow-up PR.
